# readme

**Class:** doc
**Captured:** 2026-09-27 · **By:** BuilderOS init · **Where:** `README.md`, project root

> GEO/AEO intelligence for B2B marketing teams. captoo runs a fixed set of buyer prompts ("best CRM for a 50-person sales team", ...) against AI answer engines every day, records which brands each answer cites, and emails a weekly visibility report: share of voice per engine, the prompts where the brand appears, and the competitors that appear instead.
